name: suggest_patterns
title: Suggest Pattern Files
description: Finds ImHex Pattern Language files (.hexpat) on disk whose magic conditions match the currently selected data source. Returns the candidate pattern files so you can run one with run_pattern_file. This is the bridge from an unknown binary to a structured parse. Returns an empty list if no pattern library is installed.

path.description: Path to the .hexpat file, pass to run_pattern_file
